ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) field with a macro-level ratio of approximately 88% white to 12% black across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast black pigmentation concentrated at the peduncle junction and median notch. Discrete circular black clusters (blobs) present: three distinct clusters on the left lobe (viewer left) and two distinct clusters on the right lobe (viewer right). Dense, irregular dark mottling persists along the entire length of the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 74 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 15% of the vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration along the continuous trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude variations of 5-20 pixels create a jagged profile, particularly dense on the inner half of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the leading edges of both lobes, tapering to acute distal tips; the trailing edge trajectory is generally concave from tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, textured clusters of high-contrast, brownish-tan pixel groups (barnacle colonies) localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks); a prominent vertical line on the mid-left lobe and multiple smaller diagonal scratches on the upper-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent organic encrustations (barnacles) on distal tips; multiple visible linear rake marks across the central ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique spatial distribution of five distinct high-contrast focal spots against the predominantly white ventral background.
